neighbours.label: predicates of unhesitating, unreserved action: 'quick to (point out)', 'made no secret of', 'wasted/lost no time in', 'not letting up on' (not literal quick / secret / time)
fire: Rivals were quick to seize on the minister's clumsy remark.
The coach has made no secret of his frustration with the referees.
Investors wasted no time in dumping the shares after the announcement.
Reporters are not letting up on the senator over the missing emails.
The union was quick to remind management of the promises made last year.
She made no secret of her ambition to run the company one day.
The new owners lost no time in tearing down the old stadium.
Local residents were not shy about telling the council what they thought.
quiet: The train was quick and the seats were comfortable.
The coach has kept the secret of his training method for years.
Investors spent a long time studying the shares before the announcement.
Reporters are waiting outside the senator's office for a statement.
The union met management on Tuesday to discuss the new schedule.
She learned the secret of the recipe from her grandmother.
The new owners had no time for a holiday that year.
Local residents were slow to respond to the council's survey.

short: quick to / no secret of / no time in
notes: Probing: 'quick to point out' 0.72, 'made no secret of' 0.70, 'not letting up' 0.59, 'wasted no time in' 0.49, 'eager to remind' 0.29; literal 'quick', 'kept the secret', 'took a long time' under 0.04. Output promotes eager, sparing, certainly, clearly.
